root.label: Federal judge rules Jan. 6 officers lack standing over plaque names

events.label: Federal judge rules Jan. 6 officers lack standing over plaque names

slots.name: standing status
slots.sentence: A federal judge ruled Wednesday that two police officers who defended the U.S. Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021, have no standing to sue over their names — and those of other first responders — not appearing on a plaque commemorating law enforcement’s response to the attack.

slots.name: installation deadline
slots.sentence: Former President Biden signed a law in 2022 requesting a plaque to honor the officers who defended the Capitol during the attack, giving its installation a one-year deadline. But the plaque was never erected.

slots.name: case status
slots.sentence: “Because the officers lacked standing when they commenced this action, this court lacks subject-matter jurisdiction and must dismiss the case,” she wrote.
